title: Discord Bot token: one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: boundary: "-" in place of the second "." delimiter and boundary: "_" in place of the first "." delimiter. Twin of "Discord Bot token: must be flagged (project-policy) [legacy tier T2]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Legacy tier T2 (tool-corroborated), but the cited sources do not include artifacts from two distinct owners, so the corroboration rule of docs/governance/evidence-classes.md is not met; the legacy expectation is recorded as project-policy pending review. Negative twin of discord-bot-token-actions-env: boundary: "-" in place of the second "." delimiter. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
